description: Chiggi Patches v1.12.0 — adds Nutrilio 'Local backup & restore': a button on the Backup screen that opens Nutrilio's built-in local file backup/restore (exports all entries, images and settings to a portable .nutrilio ZIP via share; restores from a picked file; no Google account or premium needed). Apps: SonyLIV (com.sonyliv 6.23.1), Nutrilio (net.nutrilio 1.20.2), Threads (com.instagram.barcelona 434.0.0.41.74), Arrow Puzzle (com.easybrain.arrow.puzzle.game 1.7.0).
